preflight_v9_diagnostic.finding: The camera-manager correction remained accurate while the recursive belief diverged. After the first large turn, the coupled x/y update moved yaw away from the independently measured odometry heading; subsequent accurate metric corrections were mostly NIS-rejected. Mean absolute odom-map versus belief yaw disagreement after the first command was 0.3682 rad. The final own-time belief error was approximately 1.54 m.
preflight_v9_diagnostic.evidence_integrity_finding: The ledgers balanced, but the attempt was marked infra_invalid because local_use_obs_risk was configured and passed to the logger without being written to run_manifest.json.

heading_method_amendment.rule: The commissioned camera observation is planar position only. It updates x/y and their covariance. Map-frame heading is retained from the independent encoder-odometry channel; camera position residuals are not treated as direct heading observations.
heading_method_amendment.rationale: This separates the measured modalities and prevents systematic camera position residuals from corrupting yaw through transient x/y-yaw cross-covariance. It is a model-structure correction, not a fitted threshold or an outcome-selected detector change.
heading_method_amendment.reanchor_policy: disabled; a single fused event can contain one admitted camera, so the campaign must not snap the belief past NIS on one camera's evidence

evidence_manifest_repair.change: Declare, read and write local_use_obs_risk in experiment_logger run manifests.

preflight_release_gate.reference_alignment: own-time bounded interpolation of logged ground truth with max_reference_gap_s=0.15
required: bootstrap evidence records one admitted camera plus the declared start prior
goal reached without collision, timeout or integrity failure
run manifest records local_use_obs_risk, bootstrap policy, command noise and encoder noise
preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every gate passes. Preserve a failed preflight and create a new immutable amendment before another run. Do not change the detector, Stage-06 gate, Stage-07/08 model, selected route, controller, speed, fusion rule or noise from a preflight outcome.

prohibitions: Do not use V8, V9 or V10 preflight observations as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower the image-border, hull, confidence or Stage-08 route-support gates.
Do not raise the NIS threshold to force rejected measurements through.
Do not enable single-fused-event re-anchoring in this campaign.
Do not edit the V7/V10 configs after this protocol is frozen.
